versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200–500 character format for improved agent-trigger clarity.

Initial release. Four-phase workflow covering PHI-safe intake of practitioner role and licensure, biological / psychological / social / cultural-spiritual factor capture, structured 4Ps synthesis (Predisposing / Precipitating / Perpetuating / Protective), provisional diagnosis with differential, and treatment-direction recommendation, producing a DRAFT formulation with risk flags and a "Questions to Resolve" list for licensed mental-health clinician review and supervision.
